Thanks again for the call this morning. We received Redwood's redline to the MSA and the Order Form (attached) and have a few questions specific to the DPA/SCCs and the proposed role delegation model. Can you confirm the following so we can take it back to procurement/legal?

Ava / team —

Appreciate the clear asks. I reviewed EquityTech's redline and our prior DPA template. High-level legal comments below; I've attached a short note with targeted edits.

- Delegation exhibit: I agree with a per-service exhibit. Draft language should (i) include a short mapping table, (ii) a definitions section for "logs" vs "customer content", and (iii) a catch-all for future services with a notification mechanism.
- Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA): we should prepare a TIA template that references our SCC implementation, encryption, and contractual restrictions on onward transfers. It should be an annex to the DPA so procurement sees it as part of the privacy package.
- Subprocessors & evidence: we'll provide the current subprocessor list and SOC2 link. Procurement will likely ask for the subprocessor locations and whether any subprocessors are in high-risk jurisdictions — be prepared to propose mitigations (e.g., contractual in-country commitments or additional safeguards).
- Audit / logs: limit audit scope to what is necessary but ensure breach notif within 72 hours and specific observable logs are made available on request.
- Data retention / deletion: EquityTech redline tightened retention; propose a middle ground where we accept retention caps for customer-specified datasets and retain telemetry for operational debugging for a shorter period, documented in Exhibit D.

Attachment: Redline_notes_LB_20261005.pdf

One ask for EquityTech: please push for the subprocessor list that shows host country and whether the subprocessor receives unredacted customer content. That will speed approval. Harrison / EquityTech legal — can you confirm if a CSV with columns (name, role, country, access_level) is acceptable?

I'll draft the Exhibit B (delegation table), Exhibit C (security measures crosswalk), and a TIA annex tonight and circulate by 08 Oct morning.
